items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 2 at 1:46PM EST until November 3 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 15 to 20 knots with gusts up to 25 knots and seas
5 to 8 feet.

* WHERE...Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm
and Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 0-20 nm.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM EST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

items.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 2 at 1:40PM EST until November 2 at 3:45PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
FFWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Brevard County in east central Florida...
Northeastern Indian River County in east central Florida...

* Until 345 PM EST.

* At 140 PM EST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between
8 and 12 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of
2 to 3 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is
already occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Sebastian, Indian River Shores, Roseland, Sebastian Highlands,
Sebastian Inlet, Barefoot Bay, Wabasso, Sebastian Inlet State Park,
Micco, Orchid, North Beach, Wabasso Beach and Disneys Vero Beach
Resort.
items.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown. Be aware of your surroundings and do not
drive on flooded roads. Most flood deaths occur in vehicles.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.
